svg.title: All intermediate stops on the selected outbound routes
svg.desc: One connected schematic, not to scale. Read each corridor leg downward in its listed direction; the 7E return leg is drawn upward on the left after an unverified direction switch, with arrowheads marking travel direction. Hollow circles are stops; larger rings are boarding, transfer or alighting points. The corridor 4 leg uses Galunggung via Saharjo; 5M uses the via Cikini pattern. Other patterns may skip stops.
svg.text: Corridor legs in listed direction · 7E return leg drawn back up the left · schematic, not to scale
Operator GTFS checked 18 Nov 2026. Route patterns and temporary stops can change.

via Cikini pattern; other 5M patterns differ
Rings = boarding / transfer / get off · small circles = intermediate stops · arrowheads = travel direction · dashed = walk or an unverified direction switch
Corridor legs show the listed direction only - do not reverse them. The drawn 7E return leg is the actual Ragunan-bound pattern.
The 7E Flyover Raya Bogor switch is a candidate from GTFS-derived listings - the physical link and re-tap fare are unverified.
Check the TJ: Transjakarta app and the vehicle headsign before boarding. No live arrival information.
